scope: pg_catalog.pg_statistic metadata only, not sampled content
privacy: PostgreSQL stanumbers*/stavalues* (including MCV, histograms and private data) were NEVER queried. Null fraction, average width and n-distinct aggregates were inspected for sanity but omitted from public GitHub receipts. Safe descriptor MD5 excludes those numeric aggregates. These metadata rows are not SQL source/compiled native code.
meaning: Per-column planner-statistic declaration integrity; not evidence of query planner efficiency, application correctness or runtime selectivity. No database ANALYZE executed.
findings: No invalid referenced relation/column, duplicate statistic keys, out-of-range null fraction/width/distinct estimate or unexpected nonzero zero-kind operator/collation declarations observed. Unexpected/unsupported kinds none. This does not exclude planner misestimation or app-level regressions.
next_cursor: pg_statistic_ext metadata (not pg_statistic_ext_data contents), then other unreviewed safe catalog objects
